Accordion.description:
A stack of sections that expand and collapse. `type="single"` opens one at a time (add `collapsible` to allow closing it);
`type="multiple"` lets several stay open.

props.name: variant
props.description: divided (default): hairlines between items. separated: each item is its own bordered card.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the title, visible while collapsed.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon.

props.name: meta
props.description: Content aligned to the end, before the chevron: a badge or count.

Collapsible.description: A single show/hide region. Use Accordion for groups of sections.

AlertDialogContent.description: Interrupts to confirm a consequential action. Focus starts on Cancel, Escape cancels, clicking outside does nothing.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The confirm button label. Repeat the verb from the title: “Archive”, not “OK”.

props.name: description
props.description: The consequence, in plain words. What stops, what is kept, whether it can be undone.

props.name: title
props.description: A question that names the action and its object: “Archive CSRD Filing Orchestrator?”

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content between the description and the actions, e.g. a list of affected workflows.

props.name: confirmText
props.description: Require typing this exact text before confirming. Use for irreversible actions on important objects.

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Hide the leading status icon.

props.name: intent
props.description: `danger` (default) for destructive actions, `accent` for consequential but safe ones such as submitting a filing.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called on confirm. Return a promise to show a loading state; the dialog closes when it resolves and stays open if it rejects.

useAppShell.description: Shell state for custom controls: collapsed rail, mobile drawer, ids. Null outside an AppShell.

AppShell.description: The application frame: side navigation, top bar and a scrolling page area.

props.name: nav
props.description: The side navigation, usually a `<SideNav>`.

props.name: defaultNavCollapsed
props.description: Initial collapsed state when uncontrolled.

props.name: fill
props.description: `viewport` fills the window (the app root); `container` fills its parent, for embedding.

props.name: mobileNavOpen
props.description: Open state of the off-canvas navigation on small screens. Controlled.

props.name: navCollapsed
props.description: Collapse the side navigation to an icon rail (desktop). Controlled.

props.name: skipLinkLabel
props.description: Text of the skip link that jumps past the navigation.

props.name: topBar
props.description: The bar above the page, usually a `<TopBar>`.

AppShellNavToggle.description: Collapses the rail on desktop and opens the drawer on small screens. TopBar renders one for you.

SideNav.description:
The primary navigation: workspace, one primary action, sections of destinations, and the signed-in user. One component draws both
states: a light panel when open and a near-black icon rail when collapsed (ADR 0011).

props.name: action
props.description: The one primary action, usually `<SideNavAction>`: "New conversation". Sits under the workspace; a square "+" on the rail.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Force the icon rail when used outside an AppShell.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned to the bottom, usually `<SideNavUser>`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Default "Main".

props.name: workspace
props.description: Workspace or product identity at the top, usually `<SideNavWorkspace>`.

SideNavWorkspace.description: Workspace identity at the top of the SideNav; optionally a switcher.

props.name: mark
props.description: Square mark (logo or icon) shown in both expanded and collapsed states.

props.name: name
props.description: Product or workspace name, e.g. "Faun".

props.name: context
props.description: Secondary line: tenant and period, e.g. "Acme Industrial · FY2026".

props.name: onSwitch
props.description: Makes the block a workspace switcher button.

SideNavAction.description: The primary action of the SideNav: a full-width moss button when open and a square "+" when collapsed.

props.name: children
props.description: The action's name, e.g. "New conversation". Shown beside the icon when open; the tooltip and accessible name on the rail.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon before the label. Default "+".

SideNavSection.description: A labelled group of SideNav items. With a title the heading is a button that folds the list away (an accordion).

props.name: action
props.description: A control at the end of the heading, e.g. an `IconButton` with a "+" to add a project. Hidden on the rail.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Let the person fold the section away with its heading. Default true when there is a `title`.

props.name: defaultFolded
props.description: Initial folded state when collapsible. Default open.

props.name: icon
props.description: The section's glyph on the rail. With an `icon` and a `title`, the collapsed rail shows one icon that opens the section's links in a panel beside the rail.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading, e.g. "Reports". Omit for the top group.

SideNavItem.description: A destination in the SideNav. Shows a tooltip with its name when the rail is collapsed.

props.name: children
props.description: Destination name, or your router link element when `asChild` is set.

props.name: actions
props.description: Row-level controls at the end of the row, e.g. an `IconButton` with a vertical-dots icon that opens a menu. Rendered beside the link, not inside it, so it is its own tab stop.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render your router's link instead of `<a>`: `<SideNavItem asChild icon={…} label="Filings"><Link to="/filings" /></SideNavItem>`.

props.name: attention
props.description: Items awaiting the user, e.g. approvals. Shown as an attention badge; `true` shows a dot.

props.name: count
props.description: Neutral count, e.g. number of filings.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the current page (`aria-current="page"`).

props.name: dot
props.description: A small leading dot, e.g. for pinned rows. Decorative: say what it means in the section title.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon at 16px. Required for top-level items so the collapsed rail stays usable; second-tier items inside a `SideNavGroup` have none.

props.name: label
props.description: Destination name when `asChild` is used (children is then the link element).

props.name: progress
props.description: Progress of the thing the row stands for, 0 to 100. Shows the percentage and a thin bar under the row. `"done"` shows a check mark and a full bar.

SideNavGroup.description:
A second tier in the SideNav: a group that expands to show its destinations. A group that holds the current page starts open and
is marked. In the collapsed rail the group shows its icon, and pressing it opens a small panel beside the rail with the same links.

props.name: children
props.description: Second-tier destinations: `<SideNavItem>` elements without icons.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon at 16px. Required: it is what the collapsed rail shows.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the group as holding the current page, when the current item is not a direct child. Detected automatically otherwise.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled. Defaults to open when one of the items is current, closed otherwise.

props.name: label
props.description: Group name, e.g. "Reporting".

props.name: open
props.description: Expanded state, when controlled.

SideNavUser.description: The signed-in user at the foot of the SideNav.

props.name: meta
props.description: Role or email under the name.

props.name: onOpenMenu
props.description: Opens the account menu. Without it the block is static.

props.name: src
props.description: Avatar image URL.

TopBar.description: The bar above every page: navigation toggle, location, search and global actions.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right side: notifications, help, account.

props.name: nav
props.description: Header navigation links, usually `<HeaderNav>`. Sits before `start`, and folds into a Menu button on small screens.

props.name: navToggle
props.description: Show the navigation toggle when inside an AppShell. Default true.

props.name: search
props.description: Centre-right: usually a search or "ask the assistant" field. Hidden below the small breakpoint unless `keepSearch`.

props.name: start
props.description: Left side: usually breadcrumbs for the current page.

PageHeader.description: Title, status, facts and actions for a page.

props.name: title
props.description: The page title. One per page.

props.name: actions
props.description: Page-level actions, primary last (rightmost).

props.name: children
props.description: Below the header, e.g. Tabs.

props.name: description
props.description: A sentence of context under the title, when meta is not enough.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Content above the title, e.g. a back link.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level. Default 1.

props.name: meta
props.description: Short facts under the title: owner agent, period, started time.

props.name: status
props.description: Shown beside the title, usually a `<StatusBadge>`.

Avatar.description: A person or agent, as a photo, initials or the agent mark.

props.name: name
props.description: Person or agent name. Used for the initials fallback and the accessible name.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech when the name is already shown next to the avatar.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Custom fallback content (e.g. an icon) instead of initials.

props.name: kind
props.description: `person` (circle, initials) or `agent` (rounded square with the agent mark): agents should never look like people.

props.name: size
props.description: xs 20 · sm 24 · md 32 (default) · lg 40 · xl 56.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Falls back to initials (or the agent mark) if it fails to load.

props.name: status
props.description: Activity ring: `running` for an agent at work, `attention` when waiting on this person.

AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping avatars for owners, reviewers or participants.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the group, e.g. "Reviewers".

props.name: max
props.description: Show at most this many avatars, then a "+N" counter. Default 4.

Badge.description: A compact label for status, categories or counts. Status must always carry a word, not just a colour.

props.name: dot
props.description: Show a small dot instead of an icon (live indicators, legend keys). Pulses when tone is `running`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon element. For status, prefer StatusBadge, which picks the icon for you.

props.name: tone
props.description: Status tone, or `accent` for brand labels.

props.name: variant
props.description: `soft` (default) for most uses, `solid` for counts and high emphasis, `outline` for quiet metadata.

StatusBadge.description: Status from a domain state, rendered with the right tone, icon and label from the Faun status map.

props.name: domain
props.description: Domain from the Faun status map: lifecycle, task, run, progress, approval, data-quality — or your own.

props.name: dot
props.description: Show a small dot instead of an icon (live indicators, legend keys). Pulses when tone is `running`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the icon name (any `status-*` icon).

props.name: label
props.description: Override the label.

props.name: state
props.description: The state within the domain, e.g. "awaiting_approval".

props.name: tone
props.description: Override the tone (when not using domain/state).

props.name: variant
props.description: `soft` (default) for most uses, `solid` for counts and high emphasis, `outline` for quiet metadata.

Banner.description: A message about the state of a page, section or system: errors, warnings, confirmations, things waiting on you.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: An actionable notification: text of the single action button ("Retry import"). Pair with `onAction`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions: links or small buttons such as "Review approvals" or "Retry".

props.name: contrast
props.description: `low` (default) tints the banner and keeps default text. `high` fills it with the tone's solid colour for messages that must not be missed. The icon and the title carry the tone in both, never colour alone.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replace the tone icon. Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a close button and calls this when pressed. Omit for messages that must stay.

props.name: timestamp
props.description: When it happened, e.g. "2 min ago". Shown under the text. Pass a `<time>` for machine-readable output.

props.name: title
props.description: Short headline. Keep it to one line.

props.name: variant
props.description: `inline` sits inside content (a form, a card, a section). `page` spans the top of a page or app.

Breadcrumbs.description: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy and links to each level above it.

props.name: items
props.description: The trail from the root to the current page. The last item is the current page.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the navigation landmark. Default “Breadcrumb”.

props.name: itemsAfterCollapse
props.description: Items kept after the collapsed menu, including the current page. Default 2.

props.name: itemsBeforeCollapse
props.description: Items kept before the collapsed menu. Default 1.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse middle items into a “…” menu when there are more than this many. Default 4.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Render links with your router, e.g. `(p) => <NextLink {...p} />`. Defaults to a plain anchor.

Button.description: Triggers an action. Pair one `solid accent` button with `outline` or `ghost` buttons; never show two primaries.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders the child element (e.g. a router link) with button styling.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches to the container width.

props.name: intent
props.description: `accent` for brand-primary, `neutral` (default) for everyday actions, `danger` for destructive ones.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon before the label. Pass an icon component element, e.g. `<IconAdd />`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, keeps the width, sets `aria-busy` and blocks activation.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` follows the density mode.

props.name: status
props.description:
Outcome of the action just taken. `success` and `error` swap the leading icon for a check or an alert and announce
`statusLabel` after the label for screen readers. Clear it (set to undefined) after about 1.5 seconds. For text that updates beside the button, use InlineLoading.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Read after the label when `status` is set, e.g. "Saved" or "Save failed". For a live announcement beside the button, use InlineLoading.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon after the label, e.g. a chevron for menus.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. `solid` for the one primary action in a view; `outline` (default) for secondary actions.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Let a long label wrap onto several lines instead of truncating. The button grows taller and keeps its minimum height.

ButtonGroup.description:
Two or three related buttons with one clear primary. Order from quiet to loud: tertiary, secondary, primary last.
More than three actions belong in a MenuButton or OverflowMenu.

props.name: align
props.description: Align the set inside its container. Default `end`, where dialog footers put it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the group when its buttons need shared context, e.g. "Review actions".

props.name: equal
props.description: Give every button the same width. Good for a Cancel and Save pair in a dialog footer.

props.name: layout
props.description: `set` keeps buttons apart (default). `joined` fuses them into one control with hairline separators, for closely related choices.

props.name: stack
props.description: Stack buttons vertically. Stacks automatically below 480px when `stack="narrow"`.

Card.description: A surface that groups related content and actions.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child (a link or button) as the card, making the whole card one target.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding. `density` (default) follows the density mode; `none` for edge-to-edge content such as tables.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`default` surface; `interactive` lifts on hover and shows focus (use with `asChild` on a link or button);
`selected` marks the chosen card with the brand border; `muted` is a quiet nested surface without shadow.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions on the end side: buttons, menus, a status badge.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon or avatar.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level for the title. Default 3.

props.name: divided
props.description: Draw a divider above the footer.

Checkbox.description: A box for one yes/no choice, or for selecting items in a list. Supports an indeterminate state for "some selected".

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the label.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the box invalid.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label next to the box. Omit only when the box sits inside a labelled Field or table row with an aria-label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value is visible, focusable and copyable, but cannot be changed.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

props.name: warn
props.description: Marks the value as risky but acceptable. Distinct from `invalid`: it never blocks submission. Pair with a Field `warn` message so the state is not colour alone.

CheckboxGroup.description: Several related checkboxes under one label, e.g. the frameworks an agent supports.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label, rendered as the fieldset legend.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Show the selection but do not let it change.

props.name: selectAll
props.description: Adds a "Select all" checkbox with an indeterminate state.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Show a loading placeholder instead of the options.

props.name: warn
props.description: Warning message: allowed, but worth a second look. Shown with an icon; an `error` replaces it.

Combobox.description:
A text field with a list of suggestions: type to filter, arrow keys to move, Enter to choose. Picks one value from a long list (factors, suppliers, entities, agents),
and with `allowCustomValue` accepts a value that is not in the list.

props.name: allowCustomValue
props.description:
Lets people commit text that is not in `options`: on Enter, on blur, or by choosing the "Use ..." row. `onValueChange` then receives the typed text.
Off by default, so the value is always one of the options. Typed text that matches no option is discarded on blur.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button when there is a value or text.

props.name: customValueLabel
props.description: Label of the row that commits typed text when `allowCustomValue` is on. Default: Use "text".

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Say what to do next.

props.name: filter
props.description: Filter options locally as people type (default true). Turn off when the server filters.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the list, e.g. while `onSearchChange` fetches.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called as the user types (and with "" when the list closes). Pair with `filter={false}` for server-side search.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value is visible, focusable and copyable, but cannot be changed.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: @deprecated The field itself is now the search input, so there is no separate search box. Accepted so existing code keeps compiling; ignored.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected option value. With `allowCustomValue` it can also be text that is not in `options`.

props.name: warn
props.description: Marks the value as risky but acceptable. Distinct from `invalid`: it never blocks submission. Pair with a Field `warn` message so the state is not colour alone.

CommandPalette.description: Search-first launcher for pages, agents, runs and actions. Opens with ⌘K, filters as you type, runs the highlighted command on Enter.

props.name: items
props.description: Commands and destinations. Use `group` to section them ("Navigate", "Actions", "Recent runs").

props.name: emptyMessage
props.default: Nothing matches. Try an agent name or a filing.
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Say what to do next.

props.name: filter
props.description: Filter locally (default true). Turn off when you search on the server.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer hint row. Pass `null` to remove it.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Open and close with ⌘K or Ctrl+K from anywhere in the page. Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog. Default "Command palette".

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called as the person types.

Calendar.description: A month grid for picking dates. Used inside DatePicker and DateRangePicker, or inline on a page.

DateRange.description: A range of dates. Unlike {@link DateInterval}, the range ends are included.

DatePicker.description: Picks one date: a reporting date, a deadline, an effective-from date. Type it with a mask and validation, or open the calendar.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button once a value is set.

props.name: dateFormat
props.description:
How the value is shown on the button when `entry="button"`, as a date-fns format. Default "d MMM yyyy".
Typed entry uses `inputFormat` instead.

props.name: disabledDates
props.description: Extra disabled dates (react-day-picker matchers).

props.name: entry
props.description:
`typed` (default): a text field with a format mask, validation and a calendar button. `button`: a read-only trigger that opens the calendar,
for a place where typing is not wanted.

props.name: inputFormat
props.description: Numeric format of the typed text: `dd/MM/yyyy` (default), `MM/dd/yyyy`, `yyyy-MM-dd`, with `/`, `-` or `.` as the separator. Shown as the placeholder.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date.

props.name: onValidate
props.description:
Called when what is typed changes status: `empty`, `incomplete`, `valid`, or a problem (`invalid`, `before-min`, `after-max`, `disabled`) with a message in words.
The picker also shows that message under the field and sets `aria-invalid`. Typed entry only.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value is visible, focusable and copyable, but cannot be changed.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

props.name: warn
props.description: Marks the value as risky but acceptable. Distinct from `invalid`: it never blocks submission. Pair with a Field `warn` message so the state is not colour alone.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday. Default 1.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button once a value is set.

props.name: dateFormat
props.description:

props.name: min

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Months shown side by side. Default 2.

props.description: Visual emphasis. `solid` for the one primary action in a view; `outline` (default) for secondary actions.

NumberField.description: Numbers with units: quantities, factors, percentages. Formats on blur, steps with arrow keys, clamps to min and max.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Intl.NumberFormat options for display, e.g. { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for display formatting on blur. Defaults to the browser locale.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Content before the value, e.g. "€".

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow keys and steppers move by this. Shift multiplies by 10. Default 1.

props.name: stepper
props.description: Show increment and decrement buttons.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the value, e.g. "tCO₂e", "kWh", "%".

props.name: value
props.description: The number, or null when empty.

props.name: warn
props.description: Marks the value as risky but acceptable. Distinct from `invalid`: it never blocks submission. Pair with a Field `warn` message so the state is not colour alone.

OverflowMenu.description: The "more actions" button: an icon button that opens a menu. For row, card and toolbar actions that do not earn a button each.

props.name: children
props.description: DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuSeparator and friends. Keep to about seven items; put the most common first and destructive ones last.

props.name: label
props.description: Required accessible name, naming the object the actions belong to: "Actions for Scope 2 import". Also the tooltip.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the menu aligns to the trigger. Default `end`, so it opens inward from the edge of a row.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Class for the menu panel.

props.name: intent
props.description: Icon-only buttons are never `danger`: the icon alone cannot carry the consequence. Put the destructive action in a menu or a labelled Button inside a confirmation.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, keeps the width, sets `aria-busy` and blocks activation.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Three dots across (default) or stacked. Use vertical in narrow rows and cards.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut shown in the tooltip.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` follows the density mode.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show the label as a tooltip on hover and focus. Default true.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. `solid` for the one primary action in a view; `outline` (default) for secondary actions.

paginationRange.description: Builds a list of page numbers with "gap" markers, e.g. [1, "gap", 4, 5, 6, "gap", 42].

Pagination.description: Moves through a long list one page at a time, with an optional page size picker.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page, 1-based.

props.name: total
props.description: Total number of items.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the navigation landmark. Default “Pagination”.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Pages always shown at the start and end. Default 1.

props.name: hideSummary
props.description: Hide the “Showing 1–25 of 1,034” summary.

props.name: itemLabel
props.description: Plural noun for the summary and page size label: “rows”, “suppliers”. Default “items”.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Items per page. Default 25.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: Offer a page size picker with these options, e.g. [25, 50, 100]. Requires onPageSizeChange.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown either side of the current page. Default 1.

props.name: variant
props.description: compact shows “Page 3 of 42” with arrows only. Default full; compact is used automatically on narrow screens.

PopoverContent.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger. Closes on Escape and outside click, returns focus to the trigger.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Show a caret pointing at the trigger. It has its own border so it reads as part of the panel, and follows `align`: with `start` or `end` it sits near that edge.

props.name: flush
props.description: Remove the default padding (for menus, lists or custom layouts that manage their own).

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show a close button in the corner. Use for popovers that hold a form.

props.name: size
props.description: Width: sm 240 · md 320 (default) · lg 420, or `auto` to fit content.

props.name: tone
props.description: `default` is a raised surface. `inverse` is a high-contrast dark panel for short hints and onboarding callouts.

PopoverHeader.description: Title and optional description at the top of a popover.

ProgressBar.description: Shows how far a task or a coverage measure has progressed.

props.name: announce
props.description:
What is announced to screen readers, after mount only: `auto` (default) says "in progress" when a bar becomes indeterminate, the new value each time it crosses
25, 50 and 75 percent, "finished" politely, and "failed" as an alert. `false` is silent: use it for many bars on one page, such as a table of runs.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible label is shown.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the bar. Also the accessible name.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend for segments. Default true when segments are given.

props.name: segments
props.description: Several stacked parts, e.g. covered (accent) and estimated (warning). Overrides `value`.

props.name: status
props.description:
`active` (default) is work in progress. `finished` fills the bar, turns it green and shows a check with "Finished". `error` turns it red and shows a cross with
"Failed" or your `statusText`. The state is always written out, never colour alone.

props.name: statusText
props.description: Helper text under the bar. Replaces the default "Finished" and "Failed"; on `error` say what went wrong and what to do ("Upload stopped at 62%. Check the file and retry.").

props.name: value
props.description: Current value. `null` shows an indeterminate bar.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Text on the end of the label row, e.g. "212 of 340". Defaults to a percentage when `showValue`.

ProgressCircle.description: Compact circular progress for cards, avatars and table cells.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the percentage inside (md and lg only).

props.name: value
props.description: 0–max. `null` for indeterminate.

Meter.description: A measurement within a known range (coverage, data quality, budget used), coloured by thresholds.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: low
props.description: Values below `low` are poor, above `high` are good (or the reverse with `higherIsBetter={false}`).

props.name: target
props.description: Draw a target marker at this value.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Text after the label, e.g. "91%" or "18.4 tCO₂e/€m".

RadioGroup.description: One choice from a short list (2–6 options) where every option should stay visible.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label. Required for accessibility; use `hideLabel` to hide it visually.

props.name: columns
props.description: Card variant: number of columns at wide widths.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Show the selection but do not let it change.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Show a loading placeholder instead of the options.

props.name: variant
props.description: `default` is a compact list; `card` gives each option a bordered tile for rich choices.

props.name: warn
props.description: Warning message: allowed, but worth a second look. Shown with an icon; an `error` replaces it.

ScrollArea.description: A scroll container with slim, themed scrollbars that stays keyboard-scrollable.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name when the region holds meaningful content, e.g. "Run log". Makes the viewport focusable.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height as a CSS length (otherwise size the root yourself).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which scrollbars to show. Default vertical.

SearchField.description: Filters a list or searches a collection. Escape clears; the clear button returns focus to the field.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a spinner while results load.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called on Enter. Use for search that runs on submit rather than as you type.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint shown while empty, e.g. "/" or "⌘K". Display only: wire the shortcut yourself.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

props.name: warn
props.description: Marks the value as risky but acceptable. Distinct from `invalid`: it never blocks submission. Pair with a Field `warn` message so the state is not colour alone.

SegmentedControl.description: Switches between 2–5 views of the same content, e.g. Table · Chart, or Monthly · Quarterly · Annual. One option is always selected.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, e.g. "Chart view".

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch items to fill the container.

Select.description: Picks one value from a list of up to ~15 known options. For longer or searchable lists, use Combobox.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when not inside a Field.

props.name: className
props.description: Width of the trigger. Default fills the container.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Class for the dropdown panel.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon in the trigger.

props.name: options
props.description: Options. Use `group` on options to render headed groups. For custom content, pass `children` with SelectItem instead.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value is visible, focusable and copyable, but cannot be changed.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

props.name: warn
props.description: Marks the value as risky but acceptable. Distinct from `invalid`: it never blocks submission. Pair with a Field `warn` message so the state is not colour alone.

SelectItem.description: One option. Use inside Select when composing children by hand.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary line under the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon element.

Sheet.description: A panel that slides in from an edge: details, filters, editors, artifact inspectors.

props.name: modal
props.description:
`true` (default): blocks the page with a scrim and traps focus.
`false`: an inspector panel that sits beside the page; the page stays interactive.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Prevent closing on scrim click (unsaved input).

props.name: side
props.description: Edge to slide from. Default right. Bottom suits mobile actions.

props.name: size
props.description: Width for left/right sheets: sm 400 · md 560 (default) · lg 760.

props.name: meta
props.description: Content under the title, e.g. status badges or tabs.

ShowMore.description: Collapses long content to a few lines with a toggle. The toggle only appears when the content is actually cut. The full content stays in the page for screen readers.

props.name: lessLabel
props.description: Button text while expanded. Default "Show less".

props.name: lines
props.description: Lines shown while collapsed. Default 3.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Button text while collapsed. Name what is hidden when you can: "Show all 12 sources". Default "Show more".

Skeleton.description: A placeholder shaped like the content that is loading. Prefer skeletons over spinners for page and section loads.

props.name: height
props.description: Height for rect/circle as any CSS length.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines.

props.name: shape
props.description: `text` lines, a `circle` (avatar), a `rect` (image, chart, card).

props.name: width
props.description: Width as any CSS length; text defaults to 100%, the last of several lines to 60%.

SkeletonRows.description: Table-shaped placeholder: header plus rows, matching the density row height.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns per row; the first is wider.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible loading message.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows to draw.

SkipLink.description:
A link that is invisible until it receives keyboard focus, and jumps past repeated navigation to the main content.
It must be the first focusable element on the page. AppShell renders one for you.

props.name: href
props.description: The id of the element to jump to, with the hash: `#main`. The element should be focusable (`tabIndex={-1}`) so focus lands there.

Slider.description: Chooses a value or a range on a continuous scale: a threshold, a confidence cut-off, a year span.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats values for labels and screen readers, e.g. (v) => `${v}%`.

props.name: marks
props.description: Ticks under the track, optionally labelled. Pass `true` for a tick at every step.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description: Minimum distance between range thumbs, in steps.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Fires once when the user releases the thumb. Use for expensive updates.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value is visible, focusable and copyable, but cannot be changed.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the current value. "always" floats it above each thumb; "inline" puts it beside the label row. Default "inline".

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible names for each thumb in a range, e.g. ["Minimum", "Maximum"].

props.name: value
props.description: One value for a single thumb, two for a range.

props.name: warn
props.description: Marks the value as risky but acceptable. Distinct from `invalid`: it never blocks submission. Pair with a Field `warn` message so the state is not colour alone.

Spinner.description: An indeterminate activity indicator. Inherits colour from its parent.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible label. Defaults to "Loading". Pass `label={null}` when a parent already announces
the busy state (for example a Button with `loading`).

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter: xs 12 · sm 14 · md 16 · lg 20 · xl 24.

Stat.description: A single headline number with its context: unit, change and comparison.

props.name: value
props.description: Formatted figure. Format numbers before passing (locale, decimals).

props.name: children
props.description: Extra visual under the figure: a Meter, ProgressBar or sparkline.

props.name: footnote
props.description: Small text under the figure.

props.name: size
props.description: `lg` for overview pages, `md` for KPI rows, `sm` for dense cards.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the figure, e.g. "tCO₂e", "%", "of 1,034".

StatGroup.description: A row of Stats sharing one surface and divided evenly.

props.name: minItemWidth
props.description: Minimum width per stat before the row wraps, as a CSS length.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` draws one surface with dividers between stats (the KPI row); `plain` has no surface.

Stepper.description: Shows progress through an ordered process, such as a filing or an import.

props.name: current
props.description: Zero-based index of the current step. Earlier steps are complete, later ones upcoming.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the list for screen readers.

props.name: showStatus
props.description: Writes each step's state under its label ("Completed", "Current step", "Needs attention"). Always spoken to screen readers; this makes it visible too.

Switch.description: Turns a setting on or off immediately, with no separate save step.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Describe the setting, not the action ("Email me when a run fails", not "Turn on").

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Put the switch after the label, for settings lists. Default "start".

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value is visible, focusable and copyable, but cannot be changed.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

Tabs.description: Switches between related panels of content in the same context.

props.name: size
props.description: md (default) or sm for dense toolbars and side panels.

props.name: variant
props.description:
line (default): an underline under the active tab, for page and section navigation.
contained: tabs joined to a bordered panel. segmented: a compact pill group for switching views of the same data.

TabsList.description: The row of tabs. Scrolls horizontally with edge fades when the tabs don't fit.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the tab list, when there's no visible heading naming it.

props.name: end
props.description: Content shown at the end of the list, outside the scroll area, e.g. a “New view” button.

props.name: count
props.description: A count shown after the label, e.g. open issues. Numbers are formatted with thousands separators.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, 16px.

Tag.description:
A label for categorising: frameworks, topics, entities, filters already applied. It can also be pressed (operational), toggled (selectable)
or dismissed. When the tag is interactive, the ref and props such as `onClick` and `aria-expanded` go to its button, so it works as a popover trigger.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not available: greyed out and skipped by the keyboard.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows a remove button; called when pressed.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the remove button. Defaults to "Remove <text>".

props.name: selectable
props.description: Makes the tag a toggle button. Pair with `selected` and `onSelectedChange`. A selected tag shows a check.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`framework` renders a regulatory or standard code (CSRD, ESRS E1, GRI 305) in the mono face, always neutral.
`operational` is a tag you can press: it does something, such as opening the rest of a list; give it `onClick` or use it as a trigger.
`filter` is an applied filter, tinted with the accent; give it `onRemove`.

TagGroup.description: A row of tags that wraps. With `max`, the tags past it are kept in a "+N" tag that opens a popover listing them.

props.name: children
props.description: The tags.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Frameworks".

props.name: max
props.description: How many tags to show before the rest move into a "+N" popover. Default: show all.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Name of the "+N" button. Gets the hidden count. Keep the visible "+N" in it. Default "+N more".

FilterChip.description: A toggleable chip for quick filters ("Awaiting you", "Estimated", "Scope 3"). Announced as a pressed toggle.

props.name: count
props.description: Count of matching items, shown after the label.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the filter is applied.

Textarea.description: Multi-line text: narratives, notes for the audit trail, prompts.

props.name: autoGrow
props.description: Grow with the content between `minRows` and `maxRows`.

props.name: resize
props.description: Who can resize: `vertical` (default) or `none`. Auto-grow sets `none`.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Show "120 / 500" under the box. Requires `maxLength` to show the limit.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

props.name: warn
props.description: Marks the value as risky but acceptable. Distinct from `invalid`: it never blocks submission. Pair with a Field `warn` message so the state is not colour alone.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Class for the outer wrapper.

Tile.description: A flat block of related content that sits in a grid of peers. Quieter than a Card: no header anatomy, no shadow.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child as the tile.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Greys the tile and removes it from interaction.

ClickableTile.description:
A tile that is one link or one button. With `href` it renders a link; without, a button. The text inside names it, so write
what happens ("Open the Scope 3 inventory"), not "Click here". Do not put other links or buttons inside.

TileGroup.description: A set of selectable tiles that behave as radios (choose one) or checkboxes (choose several).

props.name: legend
props.description: Names the group for assistive technology and is shown above the tiles. Required.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the legend.

props.name: hideLegend
props.description: Visually hide the legend (it stays for screen readers).

props.name: minTileWidth
props.description: Minimum tile width in the grid. Default 12rem.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Tiles show the choice but it cannot change.

props.name: type
props.description: `radio`: one tile at a time, chosen with the arrow keys. `checkbox`: any number, each with its own tab stop.

props.name: value
props.description: Chosen value (radio).

props.name: values
props.description: Chosen values (checkbox).

SelectableTile.description:
A tile that is chosen rather than opened. Inside a `TileGroup type="radio"` it is a radio; inside `type="checkbox"`, or on its own, a checkbox.
The indicator is a filled check or dot, so the choice never rests on colour alone.

props.name: children
props.description: Tile content: a title and a line or two. Keep to text and inline elements.

props.name: selected
props.description: Standalone (checkbox) selected state. In a TileGroup the group holds it.

props.name: value
props.description: The tile's value inside a TileGroup. Required there.

ExpandableTile.description: A tile with an always-visible summary and detail that opens in place. The whole summary is the toggle.

props.name: children
props.description: Revealed when open.

props.name: summary
props.description: Always visible. Names the toggle, so make it a short title with an optional line. Keep to text and inline elements: it sits inside a button.

TimePicker.description:
Types a time of day: a masked hh:mm field with optional AM/PM, steps and limits. Arrow Up and Down change the time by one step.
The value is always 24 hour "HH:mm", so the display setting never changes what you store.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: `24` (default) shows hh:mm. `12` shows hh:mm with an AM/PM choice.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest time, "HH:mm".

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest time, "HH:mm". Steps count from here.

props.name: onValidate
props.description: Called when the status of what is typed changes, with a message in words for problems. The picker also shows that message under the field.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value is visible, focusable and copyable, but cannot be changed.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Replaces the control with a loading placeholder while its data loads.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between allowed times (default 1). Arrow Up and Down move by this much, and a time off the grid is flagged. Use 5, 15 or 30 for slots.

props.name: value
props.description: Time as 24 hour "HH:mm", whatever the field shows, or `null`.

props.name: warn
props.description: Marks the value as risky but acceptable. Distinct from `invalid`: it never blocks submission. Pair with a Field `warn` message so the state is not colour alone.

Timeline.description: A chronological list of what people and agents did: the audit trail of a filing, a run or a record.

props.name: density
props.description: `comfortable` (default) or `dense` for audit trails in side panels.

toast.description:
Shows a toast. Returns its id.
  toast("Draft saved")
  toast.success({ title: "Materiality approved", action: { label: "View", onClick } })
  toast.promise(save(), { loading: "Saving…", success: "Saved", error: (e) => e.message })

durationOf.description: How long a toast stays: forever when persistent, or when it has an action and no explicit duration; otherwise 5 s (8 s for errors).

props.name: action
props.type: { label: string; onClick: () => void; altText?: string; }
props.description: One action, e.g. Undo or View run. A toast with an action stays until it is dismissed or acted on, because a timer would take the action away from slow readers and screen reader users. Pass `duration` to opt back in to a timer.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds before auto-dismiss. Default 5000 (8000 for errors); loading toasts and toasts with an action stay until dismissed or updated. Pass Infinity to persist.

props.name: persistent
props.description: Keeps the toast until someone dismisses it, whatever else is set. Use for anything that needs a decision or that people must not miss.

Toaster.description: Renders queued toasts. Mount once near the root of the app.

props.name: label
props.description: Name of the region for screen readers.

props.name: max
props.description: Most toasts visible at once; older ones dismiss. Default 4.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner for the stack. Default bottom-right.

Toggletip.description:
A small information button that opens a panel on press (Enter, Space or click). Unlike a Tooltip the panel stays open
until it is dismissed, so it can hold a link or an action and is reachable on touch. Escape closes it and returns focus.

props.name: children
props.description: The explanation. Short text, a link or a small list.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions or links shown at the foot of the panel, e.g. a "Read the method" link.

props.name: icon
props.description: Trigger icon. Default is the information icon; use `help` for a question mark.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the trigger button, e.g. "About the confidence score". Default "More information".

props.name: size
props.description: Panel width. Default `sm` (240).

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading inside the panel.

Toolbar.description:
A row of related controls that is a single tab stop. Arrow keys move between the controls, Home and End jump to the ends,
and with `overflow` the controls that do not fit fold into a menu. Use it for table and text toolbars.

props.name: label
props.description: Required accessible name: "Text formatting", "Table actions".

props.name: overflow
props.description: Items that do not fit move into a "More" menu, in order. Horizontal only.

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: Name of the overflow button. Default "More actions".

ToolbarButton.description: A control in a Toolbar. With `pressed` it is a toggle. Icon-only by default; the label is its name and tooltip.

props.name: label
props.description: Required accessible name. Shown as the tooltip, or as visible text with `showLabel`.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Makes it a toggle button (bold, italic, a view mode).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut shown in the tooltip.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label as text beside the icon.

ToolbarSeparator.description: A divider between groups of controls in a Toolbar.

TooltipProvider.description: Wrap the app once. Tooltip also works without it, using the same defaults.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Delay before the first tooltip opens, in ms. Default 400.

props.name: skipDelayDuration
props.description: After a tooltip closes, others open instantly for this long. Default 300.

Tooltip.description: Brief, non-essential hint on hover and focus.

props.name: children
props.description: The element that triggers the tooltip. Must be focusable.

props.name: content
props.description: Short supplementary text. Never put essential information or interactive content in a tooltip.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Skip the tooltip entirely (for example when the label is already visible).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut shown after the content, e.g. "⌘K".

Tree.description: A hierarchy people expand and select from: entity boundaries, ESRS topics, folders. Full WAI-ARIA tree keyboard support.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required accessible name, e.g. "Organisational boundary".

props.name: expanded
props.description: Expanded node ids (controlled).

props.name: guides
props.description: Draw indent guides. Default true.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected node id (controlled). `null` for none.

Truncate.description: Shortens text to the room it has and gives the full text back on hover and focus. Use for table cells, tags, file names and ids.

props.name: children
props.description: The full text. Always kept in the DOM so it can be read, searched and copied.

props.name: lines
props.description: Show up to this many lines before cutting (`end` mode only). Default 1.

props.name: mode
props.description: Where the ellipsis goes. `end` for names and sentences, `middle` for identifiers and paths whose tail matters, `start` when the end matters most.

props.name: tail
props.description: Characters kept after the ellipsis in `middle` mode. Default 8.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show the full text in a tooltip, only while it is actually cut. The text becomes focusable then, so keyboard users can reach it. Default true.

How marks are drawn. `relief` (default) draws shallow blocks: a tinted face with a fine wave texture, a thin outline and a darker side face,
and gives every series its own wave so series differ without colour. `flat` draws the classic solid fills.
High-contrast themes, print and forced colours always draw solid fills with a distinct hatch per series instead of depth.

props.description: Turns the legend entries into toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`) that show or hide a series. At least one series always stays visible.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit of the values, for example "tCO₂e". Shown on the axis, in tooltips and in the data table.

TreeChart.description: Shows how things relate by parent and child: an organisation, a supplier hierarchy, a framework's disclosure structure.

props.name: data
props.description: The hierarchy, from root to leaves. The root is drawn. A `value` on any node is shown in the tooltip and table.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the chart for everyone, including the data table fallback. Required.

props.name: appearance
props.description: `relief` (default) or `flat`. See {@link ChartAppearance}.

props.name: defaultHiddenSeries
props.description: Ids of the series hidden at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence on what the chart shows. Shown under the title.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats a value. Default: thousands separators, up to one decimal.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px. The width follows the container.

props.name: hiddenSeries
props.description: Ids of the hidden series (controlled). Pair with `onHiddenSeriesChange`.

props.name: hideTitle
props.description: Hides the visible title (it stays available to assistive technology). Use when a surrounding card already has the heading.

props.name: legend
props.description: Shows the legend. By default only when there is more than one entry.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading placeholder in place of the plot.

props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
props.description: Called with the new list of hidden series ids when someone toggles a legend entry.

props.name: palette
props.description: Colour option: `default`, or a pastel option `meadow`, `dawn` or `harbour` (sets `data-viz-palette` on the chart). Moss stays series 1. See {@link ChartPalette}.

props.name: toggleSeries
props.description: Turns the legend entries into toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`) that show or hide a series. At least one series always stays visible.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit of node values.

props.name: variant
props.description: `tree` puts each node one level to the right of its parent. `dendrogram` aligns every leaf at the right edge, which reads better for clustering and deep trees.

TreemapChart.description: Shows how a whole divides into nested parts, with area proportional to value. Suits many parts where a pie would be unreadable.

props.name: data
props.description: The hierarchy. The root is only a container: its children are the top-level groups. Leaves carry `value`; branches take the sum of their children.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the chart for everyone, including the data table fallback. Required.

props.name: appearance
props.description: `relief` (default) or `flat`. See {@link ChartAppearance}.

props.name: changeUnit
props.description: Unit of the `change` field. Default "%".

props.name: colorBy
props.description:
What the fill means. `group` gives each top-level group a categorical colour (up to eight). `value` shades leaves with the sequential ramp by size.
`change` shades leaves with the diverging ramp by their `change` field (for example change against last year), so one chart shows size and direction.

props.name: defaultHiddenSeries
props.description: Ids of the series hidden at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence on what the chart shows. Shown under the title.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats a value. Default: thousands separators, up to one decimal.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px. The width follows the container.

props.name: hiddenSeries
props.description: Ids of the hidden series (controlled). Pair with `onHiddenSeriesChange`.

props.name: hideTitle

props.name: positiveIs
props.description: For `change`: whether a positive change is the better or the worse end. Default `worse`, since the usual measure is emissions.

props.name: toggleSeries
props.description: Turns the legend entries into toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`) that show or hide a series. At least one series always stays visible.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit of the leaf values.

layoutWords.description: Places words by value on an outward spiral, largest first, without overlap. Words that cannot fit shrink, then are left out of the drawing (they stay in the table). Exported for tests.

WordCloudChart.description: Shows which terms stand out in a body of text, such as the topics raised in stakeholder feedback. Size carries the value; use a bar chart when readers need to compare values exactly.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the chart for everyone, including the data table fallback. Required.

props.name: appearance
props.description: `relief` (default) or `flat`. See {@link ChartAppearance}.

props.name: defaultHiddenSeries
props.description: Ids of the series hidden at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence on what the chart shows. Shown under the title.

props.name: format

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px. The width follows the container.

props.name: hiddenSeries
props.description: Ids of the hidden series (controlled). Pair with `onHiddenSeriesChange`.

props.name: toggleSeries

props.name: valueLabel

ActorChip.description:
Names who did something. Machines (Agents, Sub-agents, tools, models) are lagoon with a kind icon;
people are plum with their photo or initials, so work by an agent is never mistaken for a person's.

props.name: actor
props.description: Who did the work.

props.name: showKind
props.description: Show the kind in words ("Sub-agent") after the name. The kind is always available to screen readers.

props.name: showRole
props.description: Show the actor's role line after the name.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` for dense trails, `md` (default) elsewhere.

AIChatMessage.description:
One message in a conversation with an agent. Replies carry the agent's name and the AI label with its explanation, stream calmly,
list their sources, and offer rating, copy and regenerate once complete. The person's own messages are plain and right-aligned.

props.name: author
props.description: Who is speaking. Always named: an assistant message shows the agent, a user message "You" or the person.

props.name: role
props.description: `assistant` is an agent's reply, marked as AI generated. `user` is the person's own message.

props.name: children
props.description: Rich content in place of `text`: paragraphs with citation markers, a table, a card.

props.name: citations
props.description: Sources the reply is grounded in, listed under it.

props.name: explain
props.description: Passed to the AI label's explanation: model, summary, actions.

props.name: feedback
props.description: Rating, copy and regenerate controls under a completed assistant message. Pass `false` to omit them.

props.name: state
props.description: `streaming` while the agent writes, `stopped` when a person stopped it, `complete` otherwise. Assistant messages only.

props.name: text
props.description: The message text. For an assistant message that is still arriving, pass the text so far and `state="streaming"`.

props.name: time
props.description: When it was sent, in words: "09:42".

AIChatList.description:
The scrolling list of messages. It is a named log region that does not announce text as it arrives: each streaming reply
announces "Generating" and "Response complete" itself, so screen readers are not read every word.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Default "Conversation".

AIPromptSuggestions.description: A row of suggested prompts above or beside the composer. Pressing one hands the text back so you can fill the composer or send it.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the prompt when one is pressed. Put it in the composer, or send it.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Suggested prompts, short enough to read at a glance: "Summarise open approvals".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the group. Default "Suggested prompts".

AIFeedback.description:
What a person can do with an AI response: rate it helpful or not, copy it, regenerate it.
The ratings are toggle buttons with a pressed state; copying and sending a rating are confirmed in words, not just by a change of icon.

props.name: hide
props.description: Hide the controls the product does not support.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the text is copied, or instead of copying when `text` is not given.

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Shows a Regenerate button and calls this when pressed.

props.name: reasons
props.description: Reasons offered after "Not helpful": "Inaccurate", "Missing sources". Press one to send it.

props.name: regenerating
props.description: A new response is being generated. Disables Regenerate and says so.

props.name: text
props.description: Text copied by the Copy button. Without it the button is not shown unless `onCopy` is set.

props.name: value
props.description: The rating the person gave. Controlled.

AILabel.description:
The marker for AI-generated content, and the way to ask why. It names the content as AI generated and opens an explanation:
which agent and model, how confident, what it is grounded in, and, if the person has edited it, how to go back to the original.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra actions in the explanation footer, e.g. a link to the method.

props.name: agent
props.description: The agent that produced the content. Named in the explanation.

props.name: kind
props.description: `label` shows the sparkle and the words (default). `icon` is the sparkle alone, for dense cells and field corners.

props.name: model
props.description: The model behind the agent, as a version string: "narrative-drafter 2026-09".

props.name: modified
props.description: The person changed the content after it was generated. Controls whether Revert is available. Default true when `onRevert` is set.

props.name: onRevert
props.description: Puts the original AI content back. Adds a revert action to the explanation.

props.name: sources
props.description: What the content is grounded in.

props.name: summary
props.description: One or two sentences on how the content was produced.

props.name: text
props.description: Visible words with `kind="label"`. Default "AI generated". Use "AI suggested" for content a person has not accepted.

AISlot.description:
Makes AI-written content in a form or a page visibly different from content a person wrote, and gives the person three ways to respond:
accept it, edit it, or revert an edit to the AI original. The tint says "not yet accepted"; the label stays after, so the origin is never lost.

props.name: children
props.description: The control or content that holds the AI value: a Field with an Input, a Textarea, a Tile, text.

props.name: state
props.description:
`suggested`: the AI proposed this and nobody has accepted it. It is tinted and has Accept and Edit.
`accepted`: kept as generated. The tint goes; the label stays.
`edited`: the person changed the AI content. The label says so and Revert puts the original back.

props.name: explain
props.description: Explainability for the AILabel: agent, model, sources, confidence, summary, actions.

props.name: kind
props.description: `field` wraps an input, textarea or select. `block` wraps a tile, card or paragraph and gives it room.

props.name: labels
props.description: What the label says in each state. Defaults: "AI suggested", "AI generated", "AI generated, edited".

props.name: onAccept
props.description: The person accepts the suggestion as it is.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: The person wants to change it. Focus moves to the control inside; update `state` to `edited` when its value changes.

props.name: onRevert
props.description: Puts the original AI content back. Update your value and set `state` to `accepted`.

ApprovalCard.description:
A decision an agent is waiting on. Shows what is asked, by whom and what happens next,
and offers approve, request changes and reject. Reject and request changes need words, so the audit trail always says why.

props.name: request
props.description: The decision the agent is waiting on.

props.name: busy
props.description: Disable the actions while a decision is being saved.

props.name: children
props.description: Evidence the person needs to decide: a diff, a table, a draft. Shown between the summary and the actions.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title. Default 3.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time (ms since epoch) for relative times. Defaults to the time of the first render.

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Called when the person approves.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with a required reason when the person rejects.

props.name: onRequestChanges
props.description: Called with the required instructions when the person asks for changes. The request stays pending.

ArtifactPanel.description:
A panel beside the conversation that shows what the agent made: a document, table or chart on a Preview tab and its
source on a Code tab, with a version picker, copy, download, maximise and close. Resizable by pointer and keyboard.
Escape closes it, or first restores a maximised panel. Under 768 px inside a ChatLayout it is a full-screen sheet.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Close button and Escape while focus is inside. Required: a panel that cannot be closed traps people.

props.name: preview
props.description: The rendered artifact, shown on the Preview tab.

props.name: title
props.description: Name of the artifact: "ESRS E1-6 disclosure draft". It names the panel.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus to the panel when it mounts, and give it back when it unmounts. Default true.

props.name: code
props.description: The source, shown on the Code tab. A string is shown as preformatted text and is what Copy and Download use. Leave out to hide the tabs.

props.name: copyText
props.description: Text that Copy and Download use. Defaults to `code` when that is a string.

props.name: filename
props.description: File name for Download. Default is the title with a .txt extension.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title. Default 2.

props.name: kind
props.description: What kind of thing it is, shown above the title: "Document", "Table", "Chart".

props.name: maximized
props.description: Fill the layout. Inside a ChatLayout it covers the thread; standalone it fills the nearest positioned ancestor.

props.name: meta
props.description: Content between the title and the actions, e.g. a status badge.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after Copy succeeds.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Replaces the built-in Download. Pass it to export something other than text.

props.name: versions
props.description: Versions, newest first. A picker appears when there are two or more.

props.name: width
props.description: Width in pixels when standalone. Inside a ChatLayout the layout owns the width.

useChatLayout.description: Layout state for panels placed in a ChatLayout. Null outside one.

ChatLayout.description:
The frame of a conversation with an agent: the thread in the middle, a composer under it, and room beside it for a
progress panel and an artifact panel. Wide, the panels share one column on the right. Under 768 px wide they become
sheets over the thread and the thread goes inert.

props.name: children
props.description: The conversation: usually an `AIChatList` of messages. It scrolls; the header and composer stay put.

props.name: artifact
props.description: An `ArtifactPanel`. Render it to open the panel, leave it out to close it.

props.name: artifactWidth
props.description: Width of the artifact column in pixels. Controlled.

props.name: composer
props.description: Below the conversation: usually a `PromptComposer`.

props.name: header
props.description: Above the conversation: the title of the chat and `ChatLayoutControls`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the conversation region. Default "Chat".

props.name: progress
props.description: A docked `ProgressPanel`. Render it to open the panel, leave it out to close it.

ChatLayoutControls.description: Two toggle buttons for the header of a ChatLayout: show or hide the progress panel and the artifact panel.

props.name: progressDisabled
props.description: Turn a toggle off when there is nothing to show, e.g. no artifact yet.

CitationMarker.description: A small numbered reference inside AI text. Opens a card with the source, its locator and the quoted passage.

props.name: citation
props.description: The numbered reference and the source it points to.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when the marker opens, so a product can highlight the source in a SourceList.

SourceList.description: The numbered sources behind an AI statement, with kind, locator and quoted passage.

props.name: citations
props.description: Citations in the order they are numbered.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Highlight one entry, e.g. the source whose marker is open.

props.name: idPrefix
props.description: Prefix for entry ids (`<prefix>-1`) so markers and links can point at an entry. Defaults to a generated id.

ConfidenceBadge.description:
How sure the agent is, in words and a three-bar glyph (never colour alone).
When there is a reason it is available to everyone: read by screen readers and shown on hover and focus.

props.name: confidence
props.description: The level, optional score (0 to 1) and the reason in words.

props.name: showScore
props.description: Append the score as a percentage, e.g. "High confidence · 92%". Needs `confidence.score`.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` for tables and inline use.

ProgressPanel.description:
Where an agent is in a task: the steps with a status each, the current one named, time elapsed and overall progress.
Inline in a conversation or docked beside it. Folds to a one-line summary, and announces step changes politely.

props.name: title
props.description: What the agent is doing, as a short phrase: "Drafting the ESRS E1 disclosure".

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the end of the header, e.g. a Stop button.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus to the panel when it mounts, and give it back when it unmounts. Default true for docked, false for inline.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Let the person fold the steps away. The current step and progress bar stay visible. Default true for inline, false for docked.

props.name: elapsedMs
props.description: Time since the task started, in milliseconds. The panel shows it as given; update it from your own timer.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title. Default 3 inline, 2 docked.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a Close button in a docked panel, and closes on Escape while focus is inside.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the step list.

props.name: state
props.description: Overall state. Derived from the steps when omitted: failed, awaiting approval, completed, otherwise running.

props.name: variant
props.description: `inline` sits in the conversation as a card under the message that started the task. `docked` fills a side column. Default inline.

PromptComposer.description:
Where a person tells an agent what to do: an auto-growing text box, a slot for attachments and tools,
and Send that becomes Stop while the agent answers.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the start of the toolbar, e.g. an attach button or a model picker.

props.name: allowEmpty
props.description: Allow sending with no text, for example when attachments alone are the message.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Files and context already added, shown above the text: tags, file rows, evidence chips.

props.name: hint
props.description: Small text under the box, e.g. what the agent can see.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the text box. Default "Message".

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the trimmed text when the person sends. Uncontrolled composers clear themselves afterwards.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the person presses Stop while `running`.

props.name: running
props.description: An agent is answering. Replaces Send with Stop and keeps the text the person is typing next.

props.name: submitKey
props.description: `enter` (default): Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. `mod-enter`: Ctrl or Cmd+Enter sends and Enter adds a line.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled text.

ProvenanceTrail.description:
How a reported figure was produced: source, extraction, factor, calculation, review and the final value,
each with who or what did it, when, and the value it carried. Estimates are flagged in words, not only colour.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Lineage in order, from the original source to the reported value.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time (ms since epoch) for relative times. Defaults to the time of the first render.

RunTrail.description:
What an agent did, step by step: nested steps with who did them, progress, duration and the tool calls
behind each one, with inputs and outputs a reviewer can open.

props.name: run
props.description: The run to show: header, overall progress and nested steps.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Which steps start open. `active` (default) opens steps that are running, waiting, blocked or failed; `all`; `none`.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the run title. Default 3.

props.name: hideHeader
props.description: Hide the run header and show the steps alone, e.g. inside a panel that already names the run.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time (ms since epoch) for durations of unfinished work and relative times. Defaults to the time of the first render.

StreamingText.description:
Text that arrives while an agent writes. Calm by design: new words fade in softly, nothing shifts,
screen readers hear "Generating" and "Response complete" instead of every word, and the person can stop it.
With reduced motion the text simply appears.

props.name: text
props.description: All the text received so far. Pass the growing string; only the newly added part animates.

props.name: agent
props.description: The agent that is writing. Named above the text so generated content is never anonymous.

props.name: appearance
props.description: `draft` (default) marks the text as generated and not yet accepted; `plain` for transcripts that already attribute each message.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Shows a "Stop generating" button while streaming. Call your abort here and set `state="stopped"`.

props.name: state
props.description: `streaming` while text may still arrive, `complete` when done, `stopped` when a person stopped it. Default `complete`.
